notes: THE TOOLBELT · Basilica of Wires' half of the StickLoop contract.
EARN: WIRE picked up in the finds, plus depth reached, plus a
bonus for the message room or the subfloor, banked on the climb
out. CARRY: BasilicaCrawl reads effects/flags at boot.
Playbook rule honored: at least one FLAG per tier — verbs and

currency.name: WIRE
currency.earn_line: wire found in the mountain · depth pays too · the message room and the subfloor pay best

upgrades.name: A COIL OF GOOD COPPER
upgrades.blurb: ballast for the sense of place. you start each descent holding one more point of coherence.

upgrades.name: THE SPLICE KIT
upgrades.blurb: the first collapse of each descent knits back tighter — you wake holding more of the map, and the violet does not take.

upgrades.name: THE LINEMAN'S GLOVES
upgrades.blurb: shouldering through a wall that is really a corridor costs 2 coherence instead of 3. the wire respects covered hands.

upgrades.name: FELT EARMUFFS
upgrades.blurb: the standing waves still beat against you, but through felt. interference takes 1.0 coherence, not 1.5.

upgrades.name: THE TUNING FORK · A 220
upgrades.blurb: strike it on the rail (key 2) and pull your tune onto the maintenance note in one motion. the mountain's one mercy, pocketable.

upgrades.name: A SECOND COIL
upgrades.blurb: more ballast. another point of coherence at the adit.

upgrades.name: THE INSPECTOR'S STAMP
upgrades.blurb: the green tag, once found, stays found — descents after the first begin with the hatch already answerable. INSPECTED · SAFE TO ENERGIZE.
